functions.name: Liquidity provision
functions.analogue: Equity into buyers of Nvidia systems.
functions.verdict_reason: Investees pair Nvidia money with Nvidia compute; co-investors paid the same terms.

evidence_for.text: Nvidia bought $10.0 billion of stock in Anthropic, which rents Nvidia GPUs.
Nscale took Nvidia equity and notes, relying on uncommitted financing.

evidence_against.text: Google bought identical Anthropic shares on the same terms.
Nvidia's Intel stake came with a product deal but no disclosed purchase commitment.

functions.name: Collateral support
functions.analogue: Guaranties that make GPU debt bankable.
functions.verdict_reason: Borrowers and a landlord's noteholders cite Nvidia support; CoreWeave's lenders do not.

evidence_for.text: SB Energy says PORTS-Pike's financeability depends in significant part on Nvidia's guaranty; OpenAI is not investment grade.
Galaxy's CoreWeave-tenanted notes cite Nvidia's capacity order and stake.
Nvidia says it acted as customers outgrew their credit.

evidence_against.text: No CoreWeave credit agreement names the order.
Google, Broadcom and AMD also backstop demand for their own chips.

functions.name: Pricing of money
functions.verdict_reason: No source ties a round price or loan spread to Nvidia.

evidence_against.text: Others led: GIC and Coatue at Anthropic, ASML at Mistral.

functions.name: Lender of last resort
functions.analogue: Nvidia rescues firms others will not fund.
functions.verdict_reason: No rescue deal is sourced; two backed firms rely on uncommitted financing.

evidence_for.text: SharonAI says it needs further financing; Nvidia pays minimum revenue on its unsold capacity.

evidence_against.text: Nvidia can end the CoreWeave order after a 90 day insolvency.
Intel raised $23.0 billion of equity; Anthropic held $95.6 billion of cash.

where_the_analogy_breaks: Nvidia cannot create money. Its guarantees reach a $118.0 billion maximum against $266.7 billion of shareholders' equity at 25 October 2026; the OpenAI guaranty alone is $105 billion, recoverable only from OpenAI. Its support depends on the same AI demand.
overall: Nvidia gives equity and credit support to its buyers from a finite balance sheet; price setting and rescue are not shown.
label: analysis
